stem: In which of the following pairs do the two functions represent the same function? ( )
solution: Two functions are the same only if they have the same domain and the same rule. The correct statement is “$y = x$ and $y = \log_{5}5^x$” — $5^x > 0$ for every $x$, so both are defined on $\mathbb{R}$ and $\log_{5}5^x = x$. “$y = x + 5$ and $y = \dfrac{x^2 - 25}{x - 5}$” is false: the fraction is not defined at $x = 5$. “$y = x$ and $y = \dfrac{x^2}{x}$” is false: $\dfrac{x^2}{x}$ is not defined at $x = 0$. “$y = 1$ and $y = \dfrac{x}{x}$” is false: $\dfrac{x}{x}$ is not defined at $x = 0$.
form: In which pair are the two functions the same (rule AND domain)
